options.label: Local exclude only
options.description: Add them to .git/info/exclude (personal, NOT pushed) and commit just the .gitignore hardening. Best for personal tooling/worktree dirs — keeps them out of the shared repo. Tree ends clean.

options.label: Add to .gitignore
options.description: Add the 4 dirs to the repo's tracked .gitignore (shared + pushed to everyone), committed alongside the hardening. Tree ends clean, but the ignore rules become repo-wide.

options.label: Leave untracked
options.description: Commit only the .gitignore hardening; the 4 dirs keep showing as untracked in git status.
